title.narrative: Réduire l'impact de la sécheresse sur les femmes et les filles dans les domaines de santé de la reproduction et la lutte contre les VBG

description.narrative: The main objective of this $600,000 UNFPA project is to mitigate the effects of drought on gender-based violence, maternal deaths and school dropouts of young girls. UNFPA will train 40 health workers in emergency obstetrics and neonatal care and clinical management of rape, deliver 75 inter-agency emergency reproductive health kits to assist about 1,185 people including 683 cases of obstetric complications, raise awareness around GBV risks and available services, create 10 safe spaces for children and youths, deliver 4,500 menstrual hygiene management kits, assist 800 girls with final exam fees, and provide 2,800 people with psycho-social support services. In total, UNFPA will target 10,412 people through the reproductive health component, including 5,256 women and 2,368 girls, and 3,604 women and girls through the protection component.
